newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen correcting down as U.S. rally cools.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen correcting down as U.S. rally cools.

text.p: Shares were seen opening softer on Friday, after the U.S. record-breaking streak paused overnight and Nokia fell on Wall Street, brokers said.
"I suppose we'll be lower today ... it's about time. The HEX is up nine percent since the beginning of July," one broker said, predicting a drop of about half a percent for the day.
Others saw potential for profit-taking to sink the main indices even more, with one broker saying he would not be surprised by a fall of between one and 1.5 percent for the day.
Nokia was seen dragging after ending in New York at about 442.70 markka, some 3.00 markka below its close here.
